description: TY2026 MFS add-back: § 55(d)(4)(A)(ii)(IV) substitutes 50 percent for 25 percent in § 55(d)(2), and the exemption reaches zero at $640,200 (the 2026 draft Form 6251 line 4 threshold). MFS: wages $800,000 → line 4 before the add-back $800,000; 50% × $159,800 = $79,900, capped at the $70,100 exemption → AMTI $870,100.
